v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Vidi turbam magnam, * quam dinumeráre nemo póterat, ex ómnibus géntibus, stantes ante thronum.
text.en: I beheld, and, lo, great multitude, which no man could number, * of all nations, (and kindreds, and people, and tongues,) stood before the throne.

text.la: Et omnes Ángeli * stabant in circúitu throni, et cecidérunt in conspéctu throni in fácies suas, et adoravérunt Deum.
text.en: And all the Angels stood round about the throne, * (and about the Elders, and the four living creatures,) and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God.

text.la: Redemísti nos, * Dómine Deus, in sánguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et pópulo, et natióne, et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
text.en: Thou, O Lord God, hast redeemed us by thy Blood, * out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation, and hast made us a kingdom unto our God.

text.la: Benedícite Dóminum * omnes elécti eius: ágite dies lætítiæ, et confitémini illi.
text.en: Bless the Lord, all ye His chosen, * keep holiday, and extol Him.

text.la: Hymnus * ómnibus Sanctis eius: fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi: glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis eius.
text.en: The praise of all His Saints, * even of the children of Israel, a people near unto Him; this honour have all His Saints.

text.la: Ecce ego Ioánnes vidi álterum Angelum ascendéntem ab ortu solis, habéntem signum Dei vivi: et clamávit voce magna quátuor Ángelis, quibus datum est nocére terræ et mari, dicens: Nolíte nocére terræ et mari, neque arbóribus, quoadúsque signémus servos Dei nostri in fróntibus eórum.
text.en: And I, John, saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the sign of the living God; and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea, saying: Hurt not the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, till we sign the servants of our God in their foreheads.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus, te Prophetárum laudábilis númerus, te Mártyrum candidátus laudat exércitus, te omnes Sancti et elécti voce confiténtur unánimes, beáta Trínitas, unus Deus.
text.en: The glorious company of the Apostles praise thee. * The goodly fellowship of the Prophets praise thee. The white-robed army of Martyrs praise thee. All thy Saints and Elect with one voice do acknowledge thee, O Blessed Trinity, One God!

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui nos ómnium Sanctórum tuórum mérita sub una tribuísti celebritáte venerári: quǽsumus; ut desiderátam nobis tuæ propitiatiónis abundántiam, multiplicátis intercessóribus, largiáris.
text.en: Almighty, eternal God, Who granted us to honor the merits of all Thy Saints in a single solemn festival, bestow on us, we beseech Thee, through their manifold intercession, that abundance of Thy mercy for which we yearn.

title.la: Dominica XXIII Post Pentecosten I. Novembris
title.en: Dominica XXIII Post Pentecosten I. Novembris

text.la: Dicébat enim intra se: Si tetígero fímbriam vestiménti eius tantum, salva ero.
text.en: For she said within herself: If I may but touch the hem of His garment, I shall be whole.

v.en: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with beauty.

r.la: Índuit Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se virtúte.
r.en: The Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded Himself with power.

text.la: Absólve, quǽsumus, Dómine, tuórum delícta populórum: ut a peccatórum néxibus, quæ pro nostra fragilitáte contráximus, tua benignitáte liberémur.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, absolve thy people from their offences, that through thy bountiful goodness we may all be delivered from the bands of those sins, which by our frailty we have committed.
